title: Unify Night Roster into one premium interface
summary: Night, Changes, Breaks, Chat, Account and roster management now share one calmer, more readable visual system with stronger hierarchy, richer glass chrome and fewer tiny labels.
changes: Changes, Breaks and Chat now use a shared premium clinical header with larger titles, useful subtitles and consistent app controls, while Night keeps its assignment-first hierarchy inside the same branded family.
The scrolling header across secondary screens is now a floating contextual glass lens with a title and live screen context, appearing gradually instead of snapping in as a flat top bar.

Chat has larger readable text, a richer Team Chat entry, clearer private-message rows, a proper Open chat action and grouped safety and notification controls so the screen no longer feels sparse or unfinished.
Changes is visually quieter and more guided, while Breaks gives the user’s own break stronger emphasis and makes the shared break schedule easier to scan without adding new clinical logic.

Account, roster management, the full roster, shared dialogs and bottom navigation now use the same spacing, typography, radius and glass rules, with dark mode, increased contrast, reduced motion and reduced transparency preserved.

No handover time is hard-coded by this redesign. Night and Breaks continue to use the existing Europe/Malta timing calculation, including the ordinary 03:30 handover and daylight-saving transition rules.
